title: Reservation leftover pickup recovery
lede: After David Saddler's WBB Practice pickup, the leftover tripod could be skipped with one tap and then checked out as a new booking. These after-only fixture captures show the three recoveries: leftover pickup stays an explicit secondary action, an equivalent scan can be swapped onto the reservation, and the hub asks to finish remaining pickup before a new checkout.

sections.heading: Kiosk leftover pickup
sections.note: After-only. A matched before pair is unavailable: the true baseline was a live Video Office pickup of RV-0453, not a fixture, and this checkout already contained the prevention work. Captured on iPad (A16) simulator AD637556-84F9-4AEB-84C0-17457581CE72, Debug WisconsinKiosk, GT_KIOSK_SCENARIO payloads, dark, default text, America/Chicago, hour-snapped fixture clock. The simulator framebuffer was Portrait (820×1180 pt @2x); the mounted kiosk is landscape. These shots show the compact split, not the counter landscape layout.

singles.title: One leftover item
singles.sub: Primary CTA stays Scan 1 More Item.
singles.cap: WBB Practice, 4 of 5 confirmed. Primary action is still scan the remaining item. Pick up without remaining is a secondary control, not the confirm button.

singles.title: Named leftover confirmation
singles.sub: Leaving gear behind has to name what is left.
singles.cap: The dialog is anchored on Pick up without remaining and names SUP-031 · Manfrotto 535 MPro Tripod. Pick Up Scanned Items is the explicit confirm; Keep Scanning is the system cancel.

singles.title: Equivalent-item swap
singles.sub: Off-plan serialized scan offers substitution instead of a stray checkout.
singles.cap: SUP-042 is not on the reservation. The kiosk asks to use it in place of reserved SUP-031 rather than rejecting the scan with no next step.

singles.title: Hub nudge before a new checkout
singles.cap: Check Out Gear already says the Manfrotto 535 MPro Tripod is still waiting. Starting a new checkout asks to Continue Pickup instead of silently opening a second booking.

changes.h: Partial pickup stopped being the easy button
changes.was: With one leftover item, Confirm 4 of 5 was the primary action. That opened CO-0454 and left RV-0453 booked, so the next move was a new checkout.
changes.now: The primary CTA stays Scan N more. Leaving gear behind is a named secondary confirmation.

changes.h: The wrong tripod can join the reservation
changes.was: Scanning the 755CX3 during pickup returned not in this checkout, with no swap.
changes.now: An off-plan equivalent scan offers to replace the remaining reserved item and stage the scan in the same transaction.

changes.h: The hub pushes leftover pickup along
changes.was: Check Out Gear was available immediately, which is how CO-0455 was created 31 seconds later.
changes.now: Remaining pickup is named on Check Out Gear, and starting a new checkout asks to finish pickup first.

verification: Focused source tests: ios-kiosk-partial-pickup-fixtures, ios-kiosk-reservation-pickup-contract, kiosk-pickup-substitute, close-remaining-*.
WisconsinKiosk Xcode verify passed on iPad (A16) AD637556-84F9-4AEB-84C0-17457581CE72, including XCTest.

These fixture screenshots prove presentation of leftover, swap, and hub dialogs. They do not prove the substitute/confirm/close-remaining mutations, authenticated web Close without remaining gear, or a physical kiosk scan.
RV-0453 live close-remaining and CO-0455 were not mutated.
notes: No trustworthy before fixture existed for leftover pickup, so this review is after-only.
Web reservation-detail Close without remaining gear was not captured in this slice.
Simulator was Portrait; mounted kiosk proof remains landscape iPad.
